entries.title: The Isle of Conquest
body: Off the coast of Northrend, a small rocky island rich in resources: docks, a cobalt quarry, an oil refinery, a siege workshop and a fully equipped gunship hangar. Its closeness to Icecrown makes it a prized base in the war against the Lich King, and the Horde and Alliance are locked in a bloody struggle for it. Day and night the ground trembles under siege engines, while airships pound the enemy's positions.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg: Isle of Conquest (introduction, Official overview)

entries.title: The Island's Prizes
body: The docks, the hangar and the siege workshop give whoever holds them a way into the enemy's keep; the quarry and refinery feed the war.

entries.title: The Keeps
body: The two strongholds of the isle, held for the Alliance by High Commander Halford Wyrmbane of the 7th Legion, and for the Horde by Overlord Agmar.
